slot_scores.name: no_production_during_training_period
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can a skilled worker who is training new workers during a two-week period also produce food during those same weeks, or is the worker fully occupied with training and unavailable for production?
slot_scores.rationale: Explicitly asks whether trainers produce during training, directly matching the semantic hit rule for production participation during the training period.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total cost over the 8 weeks, where total cost includes all worker wages, overtime pay, and late-delivery compensation fees?
slot_scores.rationale: Explicitly asks whether the objective is to minimize total cost, fully covering the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 (H2, turn 1) and P1 (H1, turn 7) slots were resolved early, yet the agent then repeated the identical consecutive-training question from turn 8 through turn 30 without ever advancing to a final model or READY_TO_MODEL state.

summary: The agent quickly and correctly recovered the two hidden slots (objective and no-production-during-training), but then fell into an unproductive loop, re-asking the same consecutive-training question more than twenty times and never converging on a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
